data.narrative:
Modern Intelligence is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by John Dulin, Joe Cieslik, and Tristan Tager, having raised $5.12M to date. The valuation analysis considers a peer set of 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies (UFORCE at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, NODA AI at $125M), alongside broader Defense & Security comps including 2 public companies and 8 private peers.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-Progression uses the $5.12M total raised as a proxy base and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying $12.8M. Peer-Median draws on the three-company comparable set, yielding a median valuation of $400M, with a range of $125M to $1.0B. The dispersion reflects meaningful stage and maturity variation within the peer cohort.

Triangulation across these two methods produces a range of $10.9M to $460M, with a median of $206M. The wide spread reflects the extreme heterogeneity in the peer set—UFORCE's $1.0B valuation at Seed stage pulls the upper bound substantially higher, while the Stage-Progression method's reliance on raised capital as a valuation proxy produces a conservative floor. Key uncertainties include whether Modern Intelligence's competitive positioning and growth trajectory justify peer multiples skewed upward by category-leading outliers, and the extent to which early-stage Defense & Security companies trade at premia relative to other frontier sectors.
